title: Batman 2026 Annual #1
desc:
FRACTION & CHING REACH THE CENTER OF THE MINOTAUR'S MAZE!

For months, a new criminal organization known as the Torus has run Gotham's underworld. In the center of it all stands the Minotaur—the man who turned chaos into calculated order and became the conductor of Gotham's grand criminal orchestra. Who is he? How did he pull it off? And most of all: What is he planning next?

Find out as Eisner Award winner Matt Fraction and superstar artist Brian Ching confront the criminal conspiracy that has been growing since Batman #1 head-on, and Fraction and Eisner Award winning artist Jesse Lonergan explore the Calculator's algorithm of crime.
